requirements.title: LLM-first strategy runtime entrypoint
acceptance_criteria: Strategy runtime is explicitly LLM-first and supports long-thinking execution mode rather than deterministic-only heuristic summarization.
Invocation contract includes target project root, Earth root, output root, and revision identity with reproducible call metadata.

requirements.title: Earth-wide repository discovery manifest
acceptance_criteria: Strategy discovers and records all Earth subprojects with canonical project IDs and mission/scope source refs.
Discovery manifest is stable across reruns and excludes archived/non-owner paths by explicit policy rules.

requirements.title: Target project mission and scope ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests target project mission/scope as authoritative base constraints for recommendation generation.
Ingestion rejects incomplete mission/scope inputs with explicit reason codes instead of silent fallbacks.

requirements.title: Peer project mission and scope ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests peer project mission/scope documents to model interaction obligations and reuse opportunities.
Peer ingestion preserves source provenance for every inferred cross-project recommendation.

requirements.title: Planning artifact sweep across Earth
acceptance_criteria: Strategy sweeps existing planning artifacts (plan packets, state, roadmap, requirements) across relevant projects.
Sweep results preserve artifact freshness metadata so stale inputs can be downgraded or excluded deterministically.

requirements.title: Runtime telemetry artifact sweep across Earth
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests runtime traces and cycle summaries needed to reason about throughput, blockers, and failure patterns.
Telemetry sweep stores source references and supports later evidence citation in recommendations.

requirements.title: Ground graph snapshot ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests Ground graph artifacts as canonical cross-project linkage context.
Graph ingestion preserves project-era-plan-phase-run lineage needed for ecosystem-aware planning decisions.

requirements.title: Research packet ingestion and normalization
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests research packets and normalizes assumptions, unknowns, and risk evidence into strategy context.
Normalization keeps research provenance linked to recommendation rationale fields.

requirements.title: Prior strategy revision ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests prior strategy revisions and changelog history before composing new recommendations.
Prior revision ingestion enables explicit drift and continuity analysis instead of stateless generation.

requirements.title: Change detection since previous strategy revision
acceptance_criteria: Strategy computes what changed since last revision across mission scope, runtime data, and ecosystem signals.
Change detection output is machine-readable and directly referenced by recommendation deltas.

requirements.title: Cross-project dependency extraction
acceptance_criteria: Strategy extracts dependency edges across projects from contracts, traces, and declared integration points.
Extracted dependencies include confidence and evidence refs so weak links are not treated as hard facts.

requirements.title: Interface contract extraction
acceptance_criteria: Strategy extracts shared interface contracts relevant to the target project from Earth contract sources.
Contract extraction marks required versus optional obligations to prevent over-constraining plans.

requirements.title: Capability catalog extraction
acceptance_criteria: Strategy builds a capability catalog showing what each project already provides and what is missing.
Catalog entries include source version metadata to avoid recommending already-completed work.

requirements.title: Deficit and need signal extraction
acceptance_criteria: Strategy extracts unmet ecosystem needs that the target project can satisfy with high leverage.
Need signals are scored by impact and urgency with linked evidence references.

requirements.title: Integration opportunity detection
acceptance_criteria: Strategy identifies concrete integration opportunities between target project and other Earth projects.
Opportunities include expected interaction contract and dependency side-effect notes.

requirements.title: Reuse opportunity detection
acceptance_criteria: Strategy detects existing functionality in other apps that the target project should reuse before reimplementing.
Reuse recommendations include adoption path and compatibility constraints.

requirements.title: Overlap and conflict detection
acceptance_criteria: Strategy detects overlapping initiatives and conflicting roadmap directions across related projects.
Conflict output includes recommended resolution options with risk tradeoffs.

requirements.title: Strategic debt signal extraction
acceptance_criteria: Strategy extracts strategic debt signals that can degrade future velocity if unresolved.
Debt signals include recurrence and likely blast-radius estimates.

requirements.title: Execution-resource context ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strategy ingests hardware/rate-limit/resource context so recommendations are executable under real constraints.
Resource context influences sequencing and model-routing policy suggestions in output artifacts.

requirements.title: Risk signal normalization
acceptance_criteria: Strategy normalizes risk signals from blockers, retries, watchdog exits, and regression patterns.
Normalized risk output preserves reason-code taxonomy compatibility for gate review consumption.

requirements.title: Evidence provenance ledger for context
acceptance_criteria: Strategy keeps a provenance ledger mapping every key context claim to concrete source artifacts.
Ledger enables deterministic audit and reduces hallucinated supporting evidence.

requirements.title: Context confidence scoring
acceptance_criteria: Strategy assigns confidence scores to context elements based on source quality and recency.
Low-confidence context is explicitly marked so downstream planning does not overfit weak inputs.

requirements.title: Context compaction for LLM call budget
acceptance_criteria: Strategy compacts broad-sweep context into high-signal packets suitable for multi-call reasoning.
Compaction preserves mandatory traceability pointers and avoids lossy removal of hard constraints.

requirements.title: Strategy context bundle serialization
acceptance_criteria: Strategy serializes context into versioned machine-readable bundle consumed by downstream LLM call chain.
Serialized bundle remains deterministic enough for rerun diffing and validator ingestion.

requirements.title: Multi-call strategy pipeline planner
acceptance_criteria: Strategy plans a multi-call reasoning chain with explicit call purposes, dependencies, and expected outputs.
Pipeline planner supports adjustable call depth for heavy-thinking runs under strict evidence discipline.

requirements.title: Call-1 situational analysis reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-1 produces situational assessment of target project state using mission/scope plus runtime/planning evidence.
Output includes explicit unknowns that must be handled by later calls.

requirements.title: Call-2 ecosystem linkage reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-2 reasons about ecosystem links and interaction obligations between target and peer projects.
Linkage reasoning distinguishes existing links, missing links, and proposed links with confidence tags.

requirements.title: Call-3 gap and opportunity reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-3 reasons about strategic gaps and opportunities not visible from local mission alone.
Gap reasoning ties each opportunity to ecosystem-level benefit and dependency effects.

requirements.title: Call-4 recommendation synthesis
acceptance_criteria: Call-4 synthesizes candidate recommendations from earlier call outputs into structured recommendation drafts.
Synthesis enforces recommendation ID schema and required rationale/impact/risk fields.

requirements.title: Call-5 sequencing and lane design reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-5 designs execution lanes and sequencing order for recommendations under current constraints.
Sequencing output includes why-now rationale and expected coordination dependencies.

requirements.title: Call-6 KPI impact estimation reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-6 estimates KPI movement expected from recommendation adoption using evidence-backed assumptions.
KPI estimates include confidence and caveat fields to avoid false precision.

requirements.title: Call-7 blocker and risk policy reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-7 reasons about blocker handling policy and risk containment for strategy execution.
Policy output includes escalation triggers and fallback sequencing paths.

requirements.title: Call-8 constraint classification reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Call-8 classifies outputs into hard constraints, soft preferences, and speculative ideas.
Classification is explicit so planner can consume strategy without conflating obligation and suggestion.

requirements.title: Cross-call memory handoff contract
acceptance_criteria: Each call receives structured memory handoff from prior calls with bounded context and citation refs.
Handoff contract prevents contradiction drift and context leakage across long reasoning chains.

requirements.title: Evidence citation discipline in reasoning calls
acceptance_criteria: Every strategic claim in call outputs references evidence IDs from the context provenance ledger.
Uncited claims are flagged and excluded from final recommendation set.

requirements.title: Cross-call contradiction detection
acceptance_criteria: Strategy detects contradictions across call outputs before final synthesis.
Contradiction handling policy requires explicit resolution or unresolved-risk marking.

requirements.title: Recommendation deduplication and merge
acceptance_criteria: Strategy merges duplicate recommendation drafts while preserving source rationale and evidence links.
Dedup process preserves stable recommendation IDs and avoids semantic duplication.

requirements.title: Recommendation priority calibration
acceptance_criteria: Strategy calibrates recommendation priority using ecosystem impact, feasibility, and urgency signals.
Calibration output includes transparent scoring contributors for auditability.

requirements.title: Recommendation rationale quality scoring
acceptance_criteria: Strategy scores rationale quality and rejects low-substance recommendations before packet emission.
Quality scoring enforces minimum evidence count and explicit tradeoff articulation.

requirements.title: Recommendation feasibility scoring
acceptance_criteria: Strategy scores feasibility using resource constraints, dependency readiness, and current repo maturity.
Feasibility output influences sequencing recommendations and risk policy.

requirements.title: Recommendation dependency-effect modeling
acceptance_criteria: Strategy models dependency side effects for each recommendation across affected projects.
Dependency-effect model includes likely blockers and mitigation hooks.

requirements.title: Existing-functionality interaction reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Strategy reasons about when to consume already-built functionality versus build new capability.
Interaction reasoning includes compatibility checks and integration burden estimates.

requirements.title: Project obligation reasoning
acceptance_criteria: Strategy reasons about what the current project should expose to or consume from other apps.
Obligation output includes concrete interface/contract expectations and ownership boundaries.

requirements.title: Recommendation omission detector
acceptance_criteria: Strategy detects missing recommendation classes that are required by mission plus ecosystem needs.
Omission detector prevents local-only plans that ignore critical cross-project obligations.

requirements.title: Alternative strategic scenario generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy generates alternative strategic scenarios when uncertainty or conflict is high.
Scenario output includes comparative tradeoffs and trigger conditions for choosing each branch.

requirements.title: Final strategy synthesis composer
acceptance_criteria: Strategy composes final recommendation set from validated multi-call outputs into coherent strategy packet inputs.
Composer preserves call-trace lineage for each finalized recommendation.

requirements.title: LLM call trace and decision ledger
acceptance_criteria: Strategy records call-level trace metadata and decision ledger for auditability and replay analysis.
Trace ledger is machine-readable and linked to final output artifact references.

requirements.title: STRATEGY.md generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits a human-readable STRATEGY.md narrative grounded in validated recommendation outputs.
Narrative artifact is diff-friendly and aligned with machine-readable fields.

requirements.title: STRATEGY.json generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits STRATEGY.json machine artifact with stable field schema for downstream tooling.
JSON artifact includes recommendation IDs, rationale, impacts, risks, and evidence refs.

requirements.title: ECOSYSTEM_LINK_MAP.json generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits ecosystem link map artifact showing current, missing, and proposed links.
Link map artifact includes confidence and obligation metadata for integration planning.

requirements.title: STRATEGY_CHANGELOG.md generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits changelog artifact summarizing revision deltas and strategic direction changes.
Changelog entries link directly to changed recommendations and supporting evidence.

requirements.title: strategy_packet.v1 generator
acceptance_criteria: Strategy generates strategy_packet.v1 JSON output for planner/runtime consumption.
Generated packet includes canonical IDs and contract-required top-level sections.

requirements.title: Recommendation ID stability contract
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation IDs remain stable across no-change reruns and evolve predictably on substantive change.
ID stability behavior is testable and documented for downstream traceability.

requirements.title: Recommendation-to-planner mapping artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits mapping artifact from recommendation IDs to planner task intent handles.
Mapping artifact supports planner traceability and downstream audit trails.

requirements.title: Constraint classification artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits explicit hard/soft/speculative constraint artifacts consumed by planner policy logic.
Constraint artifact disambiguates mandatory guardrails from optional guidance.

requirements.title: KPI target artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits KPI target artifact with expected direction, baseline reference, and confidence level.
KPI artifact links each target back to originating recommendations and assumptions.

requirements.title: Blocker handling policy artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits blocker handling artifact with escalation triggers, owner hints, and fallback paths.
Policy artifact is consumable by planner/runtime without narrative parsing.

requirements.title: Ecosystem obligation artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits artifact describing project interaction obligations across other Earth apps.
Obligation artifact distinguishes produce/consume responsibilities and dependency prerequisites.

requirements.title: Strategy quality report artifact
acceptance_criteria: Strategy emits quality report summarizing citation coverage, contradiction status, and confidence distribution.
Quality report includes machine-readable gate verdict fields for build automation.

requirements.title: strategy_packet.v1 schema validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces strategy_packet.v1 schema and canonical ID contracts before handoff.
Validation failures return deterministic reason codes and actionable diagnostics.

requirements.title: Recommendation quality validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces recommendation completeness, rationale quality, and minimum evidence citation counts.
Quality validator blocks low-substance recommendations from final planner-facing packet.

requirements.title: Recommendation ID uniqueness validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces recommendation ID uniqueness and stability constraints across revisions.
Validator emits diff-oriented diagnostics for ID drift and collision cases.

requirements.title: Ecosystem link-map integrity validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces link-map schema integrity and referential consistency with discovered projects.
Integrity validator flags broken or orphaned links with source-level diagnostics.

requirements.title: Source traceability validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces that recommendations and claims map to concrete source evidence refs.
Traceability validator fails on uncited claims and broken evidence references.

requirements.title: Planner-consumability validator
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces that strategy outputs are directly consumable by op-plan/op-initialize without manual transforms.
Consumability validator checks required files, required keys, and recommendation mapping completeness.

requirements.title: Validator runner and aggregate verdict
acceptance_criteria: Strategy provides validator runner that executes all validators and emits one aggregate verdict artifact.
Aggregate verdict includes per-validator pass/fail and blocking reason codes.

requirements.title: op-initialize pre-plan strategy hook
acceptance_criteria: Strategy integrates as pre-plan hook in op-initialize flow so planning starts with current strategic context.
Hook behavior supports configurable strictness and deterministic failure handling.

requirements.title: op-plan strategy ingestion hook
acceptance_criteria: Strategy artifacts are ingested by op-plan as first-class input with recommendation traceability retained.
Ingestion hook avoids semantic fork by consuming canonical strategy artifacts directly.

requirements.title: Strategy revision history and diff workflow
acceptance_criteria: Strategy persists revision history snapshots and deterministic diff artifacts over time.
Diff workflow supports governance review and prevents random directional shifts.

requirements.title: End-to-end autonomous strategy run and acceptance packet
acceptance_criteria: Strategy supports end-to-end autonomous run producing all required current/history/validator artifacts.
Acceptance packet proves outputs are planner-consumable and ecosystem-aware under real Earth sweep context.
